items.title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. THE ROLE We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you. As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product. This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges. - Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product. - Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value - Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution. - Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward. - Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy. - Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies. - Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally. - Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface. - Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp. WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE - 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience). - Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell). - Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires. - Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned. - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect. - Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization. - Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly. - Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines. - Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed. - You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development. - Strong written and spoken communication in English and French WE'D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED IF - Like working in a fast pace environment - Can also speak Spanish and or Italian - Based in Paris or London so you can spend time in our offices. This is a hybrid role, with 2-3 days a week in the office. COMPENSATION We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

items.title: Indirect Tax Senior Manager
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tax team's mission is to proactively manage our global tax footprint while supporting Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all! We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams to navigate complex tax regulations and enable business growth. Our team values deep collaboration, technical excellence, and proactive problem-solving. We maintain a high-performing, supportive culture where every team member is encouraged to challenge the status quo. As the Manager, Global Indirect Tax, you will lead our global indirect tax compliance, controversy, transaction advisory, and operations initiatives. You will manage end-to-end global indirect tax operations, including compliance, audits, system improvements, and technical research and advisory. You will play a critical role in shaping our overall indirect tax strategy and compliance framework for innovative products and business models. This is a unique opportunity to build scalable tax processes in a fast-growing financial services environment, spearheading the next generation of tax operations through automation and AI-enabled solutions. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Oversee global indirect tax operations, including VAT, GST, sales and use tax, and other non-income transactional tax compliance, registrations, return filings, and payment processes across relevant jurisdictions Manage indirect tax audits and notices, acting as the primary point of contact for tax authorities to resolve assessments and disputes Provide clear technical tax advice regarding indirect tax implications for new products, acquisitions, contracts, cross-border transactions, and business reorganizations Partner cross-functionally to support taxability determinations, invoicing requirements, exemption documentation, and implementation of indirect tax requirements or process improvements in systems and operational processes Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting global indirect tax and translate those developments into practical guidance, risk mitigation, and process updates What you bring A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) 8+ years of tax experience, including substantial indirect tax experience within a multinational corporate environment Hands-on experience with global indirect tax compliance, audits, and operational support across multiple jurisdictions, including successful resolution of controversy matters with tax authorities A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing a team of tax professionals Proficiency in analyzing financial data and working with corporate tax systems or tax determination software; experience driving automation initiatives to improve process efficiency is preferred Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, changing work environment and are able to manage competing priorities with sound judgment and strong execution What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $170,000 — $200,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $150,000 — $176,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $133,000 — $156,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Field Marketing & Events Manager, Frontier Data
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
items.description: As Scale continues to build and develop its field marketing and events program, we are looking for a Field Marketing & Events Manager to support our Frontier Data team in their event and field marketing initiatives. You’ll plan and run a wide range of events, from research conferences to Scale-hosted executive dinners and practitioner meetups, and support our annual flagship conference, the AI Leadership Summit. You will join a rapidly growing team with the opportunity to manage and execute events from start to finish, drive lead generation, pipeline growth, and brand awareness, and plan event programming with the largest names in AI. What you’ll do Execute end-to-end planning and logistics for executive dinners, meetups, happy hours, sponsored research conferences and trade shows, and virtual events. Design event programs that support sales goals, pipeline growth, and deal acceleration. Support event logistics for our annual flagship conference, the AI Leadership Summit. Manage event budgets and relationships with event production firms, contractors, and outside vendors. Partner with growth marketing on campaigns and MQL reporting. Work cross-functionally with sales and engineering to define event goals, shape content, and deliver against shared KPIs. Track event performance, measuring ROI and key metrics in Salesforce. Work with external executives and their teams to secure speakers and support their presentation planning. What you’ll bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in event marketing, including vendor management, booth logistics, staffing, and executive participation. Experience fully managing and executing events ranging from small, intimate executive-level gatherings to large conferences with 1,000+ attendees. Exceptional program management and multitasking skills, with the ability to influence and drive alignment across diverse internal teams and stakeholders. Impeccable attention to detail and a proactive approach to troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you’ll be working with senior executives and their teams. A strong sense of what white-glove service looks like and the attention to detail to deliver it. A collaborative, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude, comfortable working independently and across teams and time zones. Ability to travel up to 50%. Nice to have Experience with HubSpot and Salesforce. Experience planning and running executive dinners, VIP experiences, or similar high-touch events. Experience in AI, tech, or B2B events. Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend. Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco, New York, Seattle is: $141,000 — $176,000 USD PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.title: Head of Business Risk & Controls
items.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Head of Business Risk & Controls to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business. This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows. The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations. You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business. What You Will Do Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness. Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability. Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment. Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities. Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership. Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves. About You You bring 10+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function. You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance. You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities. You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up. items.title: Product & Technology Communications Manager
items.location_text: San Francisco, London, New York, Berlin, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine. This is an opportunity to define the narratives that influence how enterprises, developers, and the broader ecosystem understand the future of AI and Cohere’s role in building it. In this cross‑functional, individual‑contributor role, you’ll partner deeply with product, research, engineering, and go‑to‑market teams to translate complex technical work into clear, compelling stories. You’ll help Cohere articulate what we’re building, why it matters, and how our technology is reshaping enterprise AI. You’ll craft narratives that resonate with technical and non‑technical audiences alike, and build programs that elevate Cohere’s product leadership and technical credibility. This is a rare opportunity to build a product and technology communications function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who takes great joy at distilling technically complex ideas into mainstream messages that can be understood by all media globally. As Product & Technology Communications Manager, you will: - Develop product and technology communications strategies that support Cohere’s business goals, product roadmap, and technical differentiation - Partner with product, engineering, research, and modeling leaders to craft messaging, narratives, and materials that explain Cohere’s technology in accessible, high-impact ways - Lead communications around product launches, including messaging frameworks, FAQs, press releases, and executive talking points - Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for customers, partners, analysts, and media - Collaborate with corporate comms to drive proactive storytelling that elevates Cohere’s technical leadership and product momentum - Work closely with marketing to ensure consistency across product marketing, developer content, and external communications - Support thought leadership for product, research, and modeling executives - Use qualitative and quantitative insights to refine messaging and understand what resonates with technical audiences - Prepare and support crisis and issues communications related to product, security, or technical incidents, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant teams You may be a good fit if you: - Have 5–7 years of experience in product and technology communications, or technical content — ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments - Are an exceptional writer with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics without losing nuance - Have experience partnering with product and engineering leaders and can operate as a trusted advisor - Understand enterprise AI, machine learning, or developer ecosystems and are eager to go deeper - Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments - Have experience with product launches, technical content development, or developer‑focused communications - Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

What you will own - Enterprise risk framework: risk taxonomy, risk appetite and tolerances, risk register, escalation policy and the three-lines-of-defence model. - Risk reporting: regular risk dashboards for the CEO and leadership, board/committee reporting, and risk-related regulatory reporting. - DORA: ICT risk management, incident classification and reporting, third-party ICT risk and the Register of Information, with a hard regulatory deadline ahead. - Licensing: operational risk, capital adequacy, liquidity and safeguarding frameworks for new e-money authorisations in parallel jurisdictions. - B2B partner and counterparty risk: onboarding risk scoring, risk-tiered monitoring, risk sign-off on material partnerships, and concentration risk. - Financial and market risk, jointly with Finance: crypto price exposure, settlement and liquidity risk, counterparty exposure to liquidity providers and banking partners, and capital adequacy monitoring. - Operational resilience: business continuity, disaster recovery, vendor risk and major incident reporting. - Fraud risk appetite: acceptable loss rates by channel, product and geography, unified across the teams that currently share it. - Product risk: risk assessment and launch gating for new products and markets, involved early rather than at the finish line. - Risk governance and culture: running the risk committee and building risk ownership across business units. What we are looking for - 8-10+ years in financial services or fintech risk, including at least 3–4 years at a senior risk leadership level (Head of Risk, VP Risk, or equivalent). A CRO title is not required, but ownership at that level is. - Direct experience in a regulated fintech, payment institution, EMI, PSP, or crypto business. Comfort with pace and lean structures is essential. - Hands-on experience with at least one of: DORA ICT risk, MiCA (CASP) risk requirements, or PSD2 payment institution operational and security risk. UK FCA operational resilience experience is a strong equivalent. - A clear track record of owning risk outcomes, not only advising on them. - The ability to give a clear risk position and recommendation under incomplete information, and to hold that position under pressure from senior stakeholders. - The ability to communicate risk in business language, in terms of impact, cost and options. - Fluent professional English and Russian language. Nice to have - Previous Head of Risk / CRO role at a regulated fintech, EMI, PSP or crypto company. - Experience building a risk function from scratch in a scaling business. - Experience with crypto custody risk, MiCA capital requirements, or Travel Rule implementation. - Third-party / vendor risk management at scale, especially in B2B or embedded-finance models. - Experience chairing a risk committee or reporting to a board. - FRM, PRM, or a comparable qualification. What’s on offer - A seat on the leadership team and direct access to the founders. - Real ownership: you shape the risk function and its role in the business. - A remote-first setup, with periodic in-person time at the European HQ. - Long-term B2B contract with performance- and OKR-linked bonus. - 20 paid working days off per year, paid sick leave, health insurance, a professional development budget, and team events.

items.location_text: Europe, Serbia, Poland, Georgia, Remote - Slovakia, Remote — Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Ukraine, Estonia, Limassol, Slovenia
items.description: REMOTE | EUROPE | E-MONEY & PAYMENTS REGULATION (EMI/PSD2) | B2B CONTRACT About the Client Our client is a global fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It builds products that help people and businesses buy, sell, and exchange cryptocurrency, serving millions of customers across 180+ countries. It is self-funded, with a distributed team across Europe, Ukraine and the US. It holds a MiCA CASP authorisation and a Payment Institution (PSD2) licence in the EU, one of a small group in Europe holding both, alongside US and Canadian registrations. Two EMI authorisations are now in flight. About the Role This role owns the e-money and payments side of the regulatory pipeline: live EMI regulatory workstreams in the EEA and the UK (FCA), the safeguarding framework at the centre of both, and the post-authorisation obligations. You report to the Global Chief of Compliance. The core of the work is regulatory drafting and analysis: governance and safeguarding narratives, internal control system descriptions, policies and procedures, regulatory gap analyses and responses to regulators, written independently and defensible under regulatory challenge. This is not an MLRO or transaction-monitoring role; day-to-day AML operations sit with the MLRO and the analyst team. What You’ll Own - EEA EMI regulatory workstream with the national regulator: governance and internal control system descriptions, policies and procedures, own funds and wind-down documentation, regulator correspondence and RFI cycles - UK EMI regulatory workstream with the FCA: governance, safeguarding under the FCA’s current safeguarding rules, and the AML governance narrative for the file - The safeguarding framework across both perimeters: method, segregation, reconciliation and evidence, breach reporting, audit readiness - Post-authorisation implementation and evidencing of the EU Payment Institution (PSD2) licence and its obligations - Regulatory assessment of payment products, payment-flow changes, agent and distributor arrangements, and outsourcing - Gap analyses, thematic reviews, remediation plans, and verification that approved controls operate in practice Must Have - 5+ years in regulatory compliance (authorisation, licensing, policy and governance drafting), including 3+ years inside an EEA or UK e-money or payment institution authorised by a national competent authority. Operational AML or transaction-monitoring experience alone does not meet this requirement - Hands-on experience of an e-money or payments authorisation framework (EEA EMI/PI under EMD2/PSD2, or UK EMRs/PSRs), taken through submission and regulator review - You have personally drafted governance/ICS narratives, policies or safeguarding documentation for an authorisation file, and can name the regulator and what it pushed back on - Safeguarding: you have drafted or owned a safeguarding framework and can explain method, reconciliation and evidence - Working knowledge of EMD2/PSD2 and the UK e-money and payments regime: authorisation conditions, own funds, agents and distributors, outsourcing, wind-down - Working knowledge of DORA, AMLD/FATF standards, sanctions, outsourcing and governance requirements - Ability to navigate primary legislation and guidance independently, and to tell mandatory requirements apart from risk appetite - Fluent professional English with excellent written drafting - European engagement location with a minimum four-hour overlap with the European working day Nice to Have - An authorisation granted on a file you drafted - Safeguarding audit experience, including remediation of a qualified opinion - Payment-system access or SEPA scheme adherence handled from the compliance side - Genuine crypto exposure alongside payments (MiCA/CASP) - Awareness of PSD3/PSR and the AMLA/AMLR transition - ICA Diploma in GRC, CAMS or comparable What We Offer - Remote-first with high autonomy and minimal micromanagement - Direct collaboration with the Global Chief of Compliance and senior leadership - Work on one of Europe’s most interesting regulatory portfolios: MiCA CASP and PI already granted, with UK and EU applications in the pipeline - Your drafting goes straight to regulators, so your impact is real and visible - Self-funded, stable company without investor pressure - Medical insurance, L&D budget, performance-based financial bonus, English classes, regular team-building activities - Fintech and crypto domain: technically and legally complex, always evolving - A growing Global Compliance Team where senior expertise is trusted and heard

items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets like cryptocurrencies and NFTs. At Fireblocks, we enable financial institutions to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Digital assets are protected from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error using next-generation multi-layer technology. Fireblocks supports the most diverse set of tools to work with digital assets, be it DeFi, Tokenization, NFTs or Staking across the whole industry. As of January 2026, we serve over 2,400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $14 trillion in digital assets, with a valuation of $8 billion and over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale Here’s the bit about the opportunity: As a member of the growing Sales Engineer team at Fireblocks in Japan, you will take full ownership and responsibility for your designated projects and clients, from the product sales demonstration up to preparation of client onboarding. You will be expected to understand the competitive landscape and how other competing solutions and platforms operate, be a gatekeeper to the internal engineering groups, assist with POC setup and testing, give demos on all advanced features related to API, handle tier 1-3 knowledge transfer to customers, coordinate workshops, assist in customer onboarding, handle RFPs and more. For this position, you will be required to be in Japan You’ll be: Joining a growing Sales Engineering team in Japan and working within a supportive APAC-wide team of highly motivated self-starters Supporting the Sales team through the entire client sales cycle from qualification to client onboarding Tailoring each demo to match the unique requirements of the customer to show how Fireblocks can support their Digital Asset goals Delivering in-depth technical presentations to C-level executives and cybersecurity professionals on a regular basis Collaborate internally with Account Managers, Sales Directors and Product Managers Translating technical knowledge and terminology to non-technical audiences Managing multiple projects and preparing RFx responses simultaneously, each with its own bespoke requirements You’ll bring: Experience in either a pre-sales or consulting position within a Fintech, Crypto or Cybersecurity company A high technical acumen with natural curiosity and willingness to dig deep into complex technologies Confident & concise communication with excellent presentation skills A demonstrable passion for Blockchain and the Crypto industry, whether it be a professional or a personal interest An analytical approach that intuitively connects the dots A proactive, self-starter mindset with an interest and knowledge of Banking, Financial Services or Fintech Enthusiasm when educating customers and colleagues The ability to work with Webhooks, REST APIs and perform basic scripting tasks Fluent in written and spoken English & Japanese Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

items.title: AI Value & Insights Associate
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE LeoVegas has a clear ambition: to be the global leader in embedding AI across the business, giving every player a superior experience delivered in the most efficient way possible. To get there, we have set up a central AI Hub, led by our Chief AI Officer, that works hand in hand with AI Champions in every function. As an AI Value & Insights Specialist in the AI Hub's Business team, you will make sure we know the value AI is creating, how we compare with the market and that every colleague gets the help they need to use AI well. You will own three areas: tracking the financial and business impact of our AI programme together with Finance, benchmarking how competitors and leading companies use AI, and running our AI Helpdesk as the first point of contact for AI questions across the company. You will work with the AI Hub team, functional AI Champions, Finance, Product & Technology, HR, Comms, Security and Legal, and report insights to AI and business leadership. It is a broad, highly visible role at the heart of a company-wide AI transformation, ideal for an analytical, curious person who enjoys both numbers and people and wants a front-row seat to how AI is changing the iGaming industry. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Building and maintaining the AI KPI framework and dashboards, tracking adoption, productivity gains, costs and ROI across the AI portfolio in partnership with Finance - Setting baselines and measure the before-and-after impact of AI use cases, turning results into clear financial reporting for leadership - Monitoring the AI programme budget and spend (tools, licences, infrastructure) against plan and flag deviations early - Running ongoing competitor and market benchmarking of AI in iGaming and beyond, covering player-facing features, internal use cases and AI maturity - Turning benchmarking findings into actionable insights and recommendations that feed our AI strategy and use case prioritisation - Setting up and running the AI Helpdesk, answering colleagues' questions on AI tools, access, guidelines and use cases, and routing complex requests to the right experts - Building and maintaining a self-service knowledge base (FAQs, guides, prompt libraries) and use helpdesk insights to spot adoption barriers and training needs - Helping capture and share internal AI success stories with Comms to inspire adoption and strengthen our employer brand OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - A university degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business Analytics or a related field - Hands-on experience with GenAI tools and a solid understanding of how AI creates business value, and where its limitations lie - Strong financial acumen, with experience building business cases, ROI models and KPI dashboards (e.g. Excel, Power BI, Tableau or similar) - Experience in financial analysis, business performance, strategy, consulting or a similar analytical role - Structured market and competitor research skills, with the ability to turn findings into clear, actionable insights - Excellent communication skills in English and a strong service mindset, able to explain AI and numbers clearly to non-technical colleagues at all levels NICE TO HAVES - Experience from iGaming, betting or another regulated, consumer-facing digital industry - Experience setting up or running internal support or helpdesk processes, or working with service management tools (e.g. Jira Service Management) WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - 30 annual vacation days - Occupational Pension - 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually - Parental Leave Top-Up - Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner - 1,500 SEK equipment allowance - Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts CALL TO ACTION In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase’s EU Legal team helps build the future of finance by turning complex regulation into practical paths forward. In this role, you’ll advise our European businesses on the legal questions that shape how we launch products, enter markets, and serve customers. You’ll partner with business leaders, Compliance, and the global Legal team, bringing clear judgment and ownership to decisions that advance Coinbase’s mission to increase economic freedom. What You’ll Do Partner with business leaders and Compliance to advise on EU and international e-money, payment services, financial services, and digital asset requirements. Advise regional operating entities on new products and services, intercompany arrangements, commercial relationships, banking partnerships, and retail and institutional terms of business. Guide product launches, market expansion, and marketing initiatives across jurisdictions, coordinating with the US-based Legal team and other regional counsel. Monitor European and international legal and policy developments, explain their business implications, and support Coinbase’s advocacy for effective digital asset regulation. Assess legal and regulatory risks, recommend practical solutions, and improve processes to support a growing international business. Manage outside counsel on specialist matters and projects, maintaining internal expertise and accountability for the advice delivered. Required Skills and Experience Qualified lawyer in the UK, Ireland, France, or Luxembourg, with 7+ years’ relevant experience advising regulated EU e-money, payment services, or financial services institutions, either in-house or at a law firm. Strong knowledge of EU financial services regulation, including PSD2, the Second Electronic Money Directive, and/or MiFID II. Digital asset expertise, including MiCAR registration regimes, is strongly preferred. Experience engaging with European financial services regulators, particularly the CSSF or Central Bank of Ireland, is preferred. Ability to manage complex projects across functions and time zones, meet tight deadlines, and drive decisions with limited supervision. Sound legal judgment, analytical rigour, and commercial pragmatism, with excellent writing skills and the ability to deliver concise, actionable advice to executives. Ability to prioritise a varied workload, work independently under regulatory scrutiny, and build processes that improve legal support. Previous in-house experience is preferred. Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human-in-the-loop practices to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality. items.location_text: Poland, United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Bulgaria
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs. You'll work at the frontier of audio AI, shaping the models behind products used by millions of people. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: - Training state-of-the-art models - across any modality. - Pushing existing models further through post-training, data curation, architectural improvements, and novel training paradigms. - Designing rigorous benchmarks and evaluations that tell us whether a new model iteration is genuinely better - and why. REQUIREMENTS We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally you bring: - 3+ years of experience in the field of AI, with an emphasis on implementing, training, and improving machine learning models. - Demonstrated capacity to autonomously evaluate novel concepts or enhance existing machine learning projects, potentially contributing to published work. - Experience conducting exploratory research to improve the quality of gathered data. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Oracle Delivery Project Manager
items.description: The Oracle Fusion Delivery / Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating and driving the successful delivery of approved Oracle Fusion change. The role provides the delivery discipline between Finance-facing Functional Analysts, Fusion Support, technical teams, implementation partners and other stakeholders, ensuring agreed change moves through design, build, testing, deployment, stabilisation and handover in a controlled and transparent way. The role is not the primary owner of Finance requirements or prioritisation. Those activities sit with the UK-based Oracle Fusion Functional Analysts and, where appropriate, the ERP Analyst Lead. This role takes approved and sufficiently defined change and ensures it is delivered effectively. What you’ll be doing : 1. Delivery & Project Management – 70% Own day-to-day delivery management for approved Oracle Fusion projects, enhancements and larger change initiatives. Build and maintain credible delivery plans covering scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues and actions. Run project cadence including planning sessions, working groups, RAID reviews, status reporting, action tracking, change control and governance forums. Coordinate Oracle functional, technical, data, integration, testing, support and partner teams so activity is aligned and progresses to plan. Escalate material risks, decisions, dependencies or blockers to the ERP Head of Systems where senior intervention is required. Maintain clear and audit-ready project documentation, governance packs, decision records and delivery evidence. Ensure scope changes are assessed, approved and reflected in delivery plans before implementation. 2. Requirements Handover & Delivery Readiness Receive prioritised requirements from the UK Fusion Functional Analysts and confirm they are sufficiently clear, approved and ready to enter delivery. Work with Functional Analysts to clarify acceptance criteria, business dependencies and delivery assumptions without taking ownership of Finance prioritisation. Identify where requirements need further definition before build starts and route them back through the appropriate governance process. Translate approved requirements into practical delivery plans, work packages, milestones and accountable owners. 3. Testing, Cutover & Business Readiness Own the overall test plan and delivery coordination across SIT, regression testing, UAT, defect management and entry/exit governance. Coordinate environments, test readiness, dependencies, defect triage, reporting and resolution tracking across business, functional, technical and partner teams. Work with UK Functional Analysts, who own Finance UAT scenarios, test cases, Finance participation and business sign-off. Coordinate cutover planning, deployment readiness, go-live activities, hypercare and transition to BAU support. Ensure training, communications and business readiness activities are aligned to the delivery plan, while Functional Analysts retain ownership of Finance training content and adoption. 4. Oracle Fusion Domain Knowledge – 30% Bring strong working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and related Finance processes. Understand the impact of integrations, workflows, reporting, security, data migration and configuration changes sufficiently to challenge plans and manage dependencies. Use Oracle knowledge to identify delivery risks, sequencing issues and cross-system impacts early. Work effectively with Fusion Support and specialist functional/technical teams without duplicating their BAU or configuration ownership. 5. Small Change vs Larger Change The role should not become a bottleneck for every small change. BAU small change should flow from the UK Functional Analysts through prioritisation and governance to Fusion Support for delivery. This Project Manager becomes involved where change requires coordinated delivery across multiple teams, systems, test phases, significant dependencies, cutover or project-level governance. 6. Governance & Controls Ensure approved change follows agreed Finance Systems and Technology governance, including scope, decision, change control and deployment controls. Maintain clear traceability from approved requirement through build, test, deployment and handover. Ensure financially controlled changes, including Chart of Accounts changes, only proceed once the appropriate Finance governance and approval has been completed by the relevant UK Finance Systems stakeholders. Coordinate delivery impacts arising from Chart of Accounts or other controlled Finance changes where they affect reporting, integrations, downstream systems or deployment planning. 7. GITC, Controls & Audit Ensure projects and larger changes are designed and delivered in accordance with applicable GITCs and Finance control requirements, rather than relying on BAU teams to make the solution compliant after go-live. Ensure project change and deployment activity has appropriate approvals, segregation of duties, testing evidence, cutover controls, production validation and traceability. Ensure access design, privileged access, role changes and segregation-of-duties considerations are addressed and approved before production implementation. Ensure completeness and accuracy requirements are defined and tested for new or changed interfaces, reports, data migrations, extracts and automated processes, with appropriate reconciliation and control evidence. Coordinate responses to internal and external audit requests relating to project delivery and ensure project control evidence is complete, accurate and available. Track audit findings and control deficiencies arising during delivery and ensure agreed remediation is completed or formally accepted before BAU handover. Ensure BAU handover identifies ongoing control owners, evidence requirements, access-review obligations and operational responsibilities. Key Interfaces UK Oracle Fusion Functional Analysts – requirements, prioritisation, UAT content, Finance training and business acceptance. Fusion Functional and Technical Support – BAU expertise, build/configuration, release support, technical testing and production support. ERP Analyst Lead – overall portfolio direction, senior stakeholder alignment and prioritisation governance. Finance / Shared Services – business readiness, testing participation and operational impacts. Implementation partners and Technology teams – specialist delivery, integrations, data, security and platform dependencies. Who we are looking for: Proven Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials project delivery experience across implementation, migration, enhancement or optimisation programmes. Strong project planning, RAID, dependency, governance, stakeholder and change-control capability. Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials and the end-to-end delivery lifecycle across design, configuration, data, integrations, testing, cutover, go-live and stabilisation. Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, defect management, cutover and transition to BAU support. Ability to manage delivery across distributed teams, Finance stakeholders, Shared Services, vendors and technical teams. Strong communication, facilitation, organisation and problem-solving skills. Project management qualification such as PRINCE2, PMP, AgilePM or equivalent experience is desirable. Accounting, Finance, ERP or technology qualification is desirable where relevant. What we offer: Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an environment where our people can thrive. Check out some of the fantastic benefits on offer: Financial: Competitive salary; Hybrid working: Our employees can work from home up to 80% of the time with 20% of office time built in to ensure we get some face-to-face collaborative team time - and the chance for a coffee and a catch-up!; Holiday entitlement; eLearning; Family Support: Industry-leading maternity and paternity leave and paid time off if you have caring responsibilities; Health & wellbeing: Tools and services to help support your well-being, including support with mental health and financial education. You will also have access to gym discounts; Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive healthcare benefits; ...and more. More about evoke We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888, and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction, and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke . At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you. Apply At evoke, we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth. Sound good? Then you belong at our place! The first step in the recruitment process is kickstarting your application, followed by an initial screening call and an interview stage.

The role combines deep backend and infrastructure work with strong product judgment, with opportunities to work across agent runtimes, orchestration, search, execution environments, identity and permissions, observability, and evaluations. This is software and systems engineering rather than model training: success comes from strong backend fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to turn fast-moving research capabilities into dependable production primitives. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Internal Tools Recruiting team partners with Infrastructure, Engineering Excellence, and other technical orgs to build the teams behind Robinhood’s products and infrastructure. We work closely with hiring leaders to plan hiring, build strong pipelines, and deliver a high-quality, consistent candidate experience. We care about clear communication, strong partnerships, and continuously improving how we hire. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you’ll own full-cycle recruiting across a range of specialized engineering roles. You’ll partner with hiring managers to define what great looks like, develop effective sourcing strategies, and drive consistent pipeline activity. You’ll collaborate closely with peer recruiters and sourcers to share insights, improve workflows, and keep hiring moving efficiently. This role is based in our Chicago, IL and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Manage full-cycle recruiting for roles across technical teams, from initial outreach through offer acceptance Build and maintain candidate pipelines using research, outreach, and sourcing strategies beyond inbound applications Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, align on candidate profiles, and provide updates on hiring progress Collaborate with recruiters and sourcers to share pipeline insights, coordinate interview activity, and improve hiring efficiency Use tools such as Greenhouse, Gem, and AI-supported sourcing tools to track candidates, organize workflows, and improve outreach effectiveness What you bring 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience hiring for specialized technical roles Experience sourcing and engaging passive candidates using research, outreach, and recruiting tools Ability to partner with hiring managers and provide clear updates on pipeline activity, challenges, and hiring progress Experience using an applicant tracking system (such as Greenhouse) and sourcing tools (such as Gem or similar platforms) Ability to manage multiple roles at once and adapt to changing hiring priorities while maintaining organized workflows Comfort using AI tools in recruiting workflows, with an interest in building new custom tools to improve sourcing, research, and candidate engagement What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. The EE Legal Platforms team owns and operates Coinbase's legal technology stack, including Ironclad, Evisort, Brightflag, DocuSign, and a deep integration ecosystem spanning Salesforce, Snowflake, Workato, Zip, Symphony, and Slack. As an Enterprise Engineer, you'll build and operate the workflows, integrations, and data foundations that keep Legal systems auditable, reliable, and scalable. You'll partner directly with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver platform improvements and automation across the legal toolchain. What you'll do: Own Ironclad architecture, workflows, and contract lifecycle management, including integrations to upstream and downstream systems. Build and maintain system integrations using Workato and APIs, including automation that reduces manual intake and fulfillment work across Legal platforms. Support and evolve adjacent Legal Platforms such as Evisort, Brightflag, and DocuSign, with a focus on workflows, integrations, and operational reliability. Execute data migrations, backfills, reconciliations, and ongoing data hygiene to maintain system integrity across the legal toolchain. Govern platform access and credentials for Legal systems, including service account and token lifecycle management, access controls, and operational documentation. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver cross-functional outcomes and ship changes safely to production. items.title: Market Research Lead, ChatGPT
items.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. We develop strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage of OpenAI’s products and platform, helping people and businesses understand and realize the value of AI. The Marketing Insights & Analytics team develops a deep understanding of markets, audiences, behaviors, attitudes, and needs to inform marketing, product, and business decisions. We partner across OpenAI to build foundational audience understanding, shape marketing strategy, inform thought leadership, and measure performance. About the Role As Market Research Lead, ChatGPT you will help shape our Insights & Analytics strategy and set research direction for a major business area or cross-functional initiative. As a senior individual contributor, you will independently define and lead multiple complex research workstreams, connecting audience behavior, perceptions, and feedback to decisions across product, brand, and growth. You will anticipate emerging business questions, bring structure to ambiguous challenges, and translate research into recommendations that influence senior leadership. Alongside delivering hands-on research, you will establish methodological standards, develop foundational research frameworks, and mentor experienced peers. In this role, you will: - Set research strategy, priorities, and goals for a major business area, aligning the research agenda with critical decisions and anticipating future needs. - Independently define, prioritize, and lead multiple complex quantitative and qualitative research workstreams, balancing business impact, rigor, speed, and resources. - Serve as a strategic partner to brand, product marketing, creative, product, and other teams, helping shape business strategy and goals through insights. - Address challenges such as reaching new audiences, evolving our brand, positioning our product suite, and improving experiences. - Connect primary research with behavioral data and other evidence, partnering with analytics colleagues to build a holistic understanding of our audiences. - Translate complex findings into clear narratives and actionable recommendations that influence senior leaders and align stakeholders around decisions. - Set technical and quality standards for research design, execution, analysis, and interpretation, including work delivered by agencies and vendors. - Develop reusable frameworks and foundational research that strengthen the team’s ability to answer complex questions over time. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 12+ years of experience in mixed-method market research and data analysis, with deep expertise in quantitative and qualitative methods. - A track record of setting research strategy and independently leading multiple complex workstreams across a substantial business area or cross-functional initiative. - Strong judgment in ambiguous situations, including identifying the right questions, prioritizing competing needs, and choosing methods that support consequential decisions. - Hands-on expertise across the full research lifecycle, including instrument design, sampling, weighting, statistical analysis, and reporting. - Demonstrated success synthesizing evidence from multiple sources into recommendations that influence senior leadership and marketing, product, or business strategy. - Experience spanning product or go-to-market research, positioning and messaging, brand strategy, campaign development, and tracking. - Experience conducting global research and managing agencies or vendors to deliver high-quality outcomes. - Experience establishing research standards, developing reusable frameworks, and mentoring experienced researchers or cross-functional peers. - Proficiency with statistical analysis and survey programming. - Excited to make AI part of how you work—actively experimenting with new tools and finding practical ways to improve the quality, speed, and impact of your work About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
