items.title: Podcast Media Manager
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Podcast Media Manager at Anthropic, you will own how Claude shows up in podcasts, one of our most important channels for reaching professionals and knowledge workers. This is not a traditional media buying role. We're looking for someone to build a refreshed, proactive podcast strategy: securing the right shows before they're obvious, going beyond standard ad reads, and creating unique partnerships that fully integrate our product into shows in ways no other brand is doing. In this role, you'll own our podcast program end to end, from annual strategy and show selection through network buys, scripts, pacing, and reporting across 100+ shows. You'll sit on the influencer marketing team and partner closely with growth marketing on performance goals and in-house campaigns, brand marketing on major campaign flights, enterprise marketing on B2B buys and scripts, creative and copy teams on reads and refreshes, comms teams on messaging and media buying teams/agencies on execution. Key responsibilities Own podcast strategy for Anthropic, setting where we show up instead of reacting to inbound pitches Lead podcast strategy flights for major campaigns end to end, from planning through reporting Manage network buys across major audio publishers including Spotify, Amazon, NYT, and others Develop year-long buys with top shows and media outlets, identifying and pitching partners before they come to us Build partnership packages that go beyond ad reads to include bonus episodes, video, live events, and social Partner with creative and copy teams as their main point of contact on podcast work, establishing a repeatable process for scripts and copy points Manage voice-actor reads and QA spots before they air Develop a refresh cadence for reads so messaging stays current across 100+ shows, tailored to each show's audience Manage agency relationships, pushing partners to deliver the best rates, placements, and ideas Track pacing across buys and shift budget as performance data comes in Present results and learnings back to the team on a regular basis Partner with growth, brand, and enterprise marketing to align podcast plans with performance goals, campaign flights, and B2B objectives Minimum qualifications Have deep experience in podcast media buying at a tech or consumer company with a substantial podcast budget Have managed podcast programs in-house directly, not only through an agency Have run both agency partnerships and in-house podcast programs, and know how to get the best work out of each Are skilled at managing and pushing media agencies to secure strong rates, placements, and ideas Can spot up-and-coming shows before they're obvious and back your picks with a clear rationale Bring creative ideas that go beyond the standard ad read, from bonus episodes to live events to product integrations Are comfortable owning the details of execution, including scripts, QA, pacing, and reporting, alongside long-range strategy Work well across many partner teams and can build repeatable processes that scale Enjoy shaping a program from the ground up rather than maintaining an existing playbook Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications Experience negotiating year-long or multi-format partnerships with top shows or networks A background in copywriting or close collaboration with creative teams on host-read scripts Familiarity with B2B audiences and enterprise-focused podcast buys Experience with podcast measurement, attribution, and incrementality testing Relationships with major audio publishers, networks, and independent hosts Experience extending podcast partnerships into video, social, or live formats Familiarity with AI products or the broader developer and knowledge worker audience The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $200,000 — $255,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Mission Control
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world’s largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized “house,” Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast – both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Staff Full-Stack Engineer to define the technical strategy and long-term architecture of the systems that power how Polymarket operates. You’ll partner with leaders across the company, understand their strategic goals at a deep level, and shape how our operational platform evolves to meet them. These systems center on Mission Control: the internal platform Polymarket uses to run Polymarket. Mission Control is the backbone for teams across the company, including Markets, Product, Polymarket US, Trust & Safety, Compliance, Exchange Operations, and Customer Experience. It is critical to how we create, configure, and launch markets, and to how we operate safely and compliantly at scale. This is a role for an experienced technical leader who wants broad ownership, influence across the organization, and a direct hand in how Polymarket operates as it scales. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own and lead Mission Control. Set the technical vision and roadmap for the platform used to run Polymarket, the engine behind our markets, operations, compliance, and growth. - Build Mission Control as a platform. Design the core abstractions, data models, and extension points that let teams across the company build on Mission Control safely and quickly, without a dedicated engineer for every workflow. - Architect markets automation at scale. Drive the design of systems that change how markets are researched, structured, deployed, and managed as volume grows. - Make high-stakes technical decisions. Lead architecture and design reviews, weigh tradeoffs across reliability, security, compliance, and speed, and make sure our systems meet the standards of a regulated exchange. - Influence beyond your team. Work with core product, infrastructure, and data teams to align on interfaces, shared services, and standards. Identify problems across the company before they become blockers. - Embed with and partner across teams. Work directly with leaders in Markets, Product, Polymarket US, Trust & Safety, Compliance, Operations, and CX to turn their strategic goals into technical priorities and shape how their teams work. - Multiply the team. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, set the engineering culture and quality bar, and help shape hiring and team growth. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 8+ years of professional software development experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect on production systems - Deep expertise designing, building, and scaling full-stack web applications and platforms - Expert-level skills in TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS - Extensive experience with React and Node.js (Next.js is a bonus) - A track record of setting technical direction and delivering large, cross-team initiatives from strategy through execution - Exceptional system design skills, including designing platforms that other teams build on - Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment among engineering, product, and business leaders - Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture, standards, and hiring - Strong customer empathy: you understand what teams actually need, not just what they ask for - Strong judgment under ambiguity: you know when to move fast, when to invest for the long term, and how to explain the difference - Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clear technical strategy and present tradeoffs to executives - A passion for blockchain, decentralized finance, and freedom of speech - (Plus) Experience building internal platforms or tooling for compliance, AML, surveillance, risk, or trading operations - (Plus) Experience in a regulated environment such as an exchange, brokerage, or financial institution - (Plus) Experience in an embedded or field engineering role, working directly alongside product or operations teams - (Plus) Experience with workflow automation or deployment pipelines - (Plus) Background in fintech, crypto, exchanges, or data-heavy applications - (Plus) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full health, vision, & dental coverage - 401(k) match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. Job Description As a Data Engineer, you will be a member of the Data Science & Analytics team building the foundation to scale analytics across our organization. You will collaborate with key stakeholders in Engineering, Product, and other areas to build scalable solutions to transform data into key metrics reporting and insights. You will be responsible for ensuring teams have access to reliable, accurate metrics for consumer products from idea to implementation. You will also lead your own projects to enable self-serve insights to help teams make data-driven decisions. Responsibilities : Understand and whenever possible proactively identify the data needs of stakeholder teams in terms of key data models and reporting, and translate that into technical requirements Define, build and manage key data pipelines in dbt that transform raw logs into canonical datasets Establish high data integrity standards and SLAs to ensure timely, accurate delivery of data Develop insightful and reliable dashboards to track performance of core metrics that will deliver insights to the whole company Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools to enable self-serve analytics to scale across the company Closely partner with stakeholders to define and materialize metrics and analysis for new and evolving consumer products in a fast paced environment Influence the future roadmap of Product teams from a data systems perspective Become an expert in our organization’s data models and the company's data architecture You might be a good fit if you have: 7+ years of experience as an Data Engineer or similar Data Science & Analytics roles, preferably partnering with Product leads to build and report on key company-wide metrics. items.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer - KICK
items.description: Easygo is an Australian technology powerhouse behind global brands Stake, KICK and Easygo Gaming. As we continue to grow our engineering presence in Belgrade, we’re looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to join the DevOps/Platform team behind Kick.com, our live video streaming platform serving more than 130M users worldwide. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving real production challenges and building the platform that other engineers ship on. Over the coming year, the same platform will be extended to provision environments, delivery pipelines and shared services for products across Easygo. You’ll help make these capabilities accessible to teams beyond Kick. Who We’re Looking For As a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer at Easygo, you’ll contribute to the design, implementation and operation of the cloud platform our engineering organisation builds on, as well as the shared services our products consume. This includes the real-time messaging infrastructure that delivers chat to millions of concurrent viewers. You’ll work closely with software engineers, platform teams and security to help keep our systems highly available, observable and resilient at scale. You’ll also participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, collaborating with teammates across Melbourne and Belgrade to support production and improve how we operate. We value engineers who take ownership, think pragmatically and enjoy working hands-on with real systems. You treat the engineers using your platform as your customers and look for ways to reduce friction, improve reliability and get things done. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy and operate shared platform services, including our real-time messaging platform running on Kubernetes at high connection volumes. Architect and design scalable, high-performance infrastructure solutions aligned with project requirements and company standards. Optimise existing systems for performance, scalability and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies. Build self-service capabilities and reusable patterns that reduce friction for engineers using our platform. Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure and environments using AWS (EKS), Terraform and ArgoCD, enabling new services to be set up quickly and consistently. Own delivery tooling, including GitHub Actions pipelines, deployment safety and release tooling that helps engineers ship confidently and roll back quickly. Improve and own monitoring, logging and observability (Datadog / Cloudflare), making the platform’s behaviour visible to the teams that depend on it. Help new Easygo products reach their first production deployment using existing platform patterns. Plan for and support large-scale live events, including load testing, capacity planning, autoscaling behaviour, readiness reviews and hands-on support during events. Ensure systems are secure and protected from vulnerabilities, maintaining security as systems evolve. Contribute hands-on code and development work, ensuring code quality, scalability and maintainability. Lead projects end to end across both offices, keeping progress and decisions documented so colleagues in Belgrade and Melbourne are equally informed. Use AI tooling to improve processes and reduce repetitive work. Participate in the follow-the-sun on-call rotation. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 6+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps or software engineering, with a focus on scalable system design and development. Experience with AWS EKS (Kubernetes), Terraform and Datadog / Cloudflare. Experience with AWS native services, including EC2, RDS, ElastiCache and IAM. Familiarity with technologies including Terraform, Golang and NodeJS/TypeScript. Experience with complex microservices architectures, high user volumes and large-scale distributed systems. Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS and VPCs. Understanding of security best practices and experience implementing them. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges at scale. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working as part of a distributed team across time zones. A strong sense of accountability and ownership, with a focus on getting things done. Preferred Qualifications Experience with real-time messaging systems or running services with high connection volumes. Experience with load testing and event readiness for high-traffic live platforms. Experience with CI/CD tooling such as ArgoCD and GitHub Actions. Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling. Why Join Easygo? Engineering Environment: Work with a team tackling technical challenges at a scale few platforms reach, with room to experiment, explore ideas and keep learning. Professional Growth: Opportunities to develop your expertise and progress within a growing global technology organisation. Performance Reward: An annual bonus linked to individual and company performance. Health & Family Support: Private health insurance for you and your dependants, plus 15 working days of paid paternity leave. Office Perks: Daily catered lunch, snacks and beverages, parking reimbursement and a modern Belgrade office. Global Exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, and occasionally visit, our Melbourne headquarters. We’re an office-first team based in Belgrade, where working side by side makes it easier to exchange ideas, tackle challenges and learn from each other. However, we do offer flexibility to work from home up to two days a week. Come as you are. Be part of something bigger. Click play on your career today.

You will serve as a primary technical leader across the Bitstamp exchange ecosystem—architecting the next generation of cloud infrastructure for mission-critical, low-latency services, driving complex distributed systems integrations, and elevating the technical bar across Robinhood. This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs. What you’ll do Architect Strategic Infrastructure : Define and drive the long-term architectural vision for high-availability, low-latency cloud platforms, setting engineering standards that ensure performance, reliability, and portability across our global ecosystem. Lead Modernization at Scale: Spearhead multi-quarter modernization initiatives, driving the transition of foundational services to resilient, containerized cloud environments while optimizing deployment pipelines and auto-scaling patterns. Direct High-Stakes Integrations: Lead the technical alignment and distributed architecture bridging Bitstamp’s exchange backend with Robinhood’s global infrastructure, solving complex cross-organization technical challenges. Eliminate Operational Toil & Technical Debt: Anticipate future scalability bottlenecks and architect self-healing systems and intelligent automation that radically reduce operational load and boost developer velocity. Exercise Systemic Ownership : Take end-to-end accountability for ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives—navigating complex trade-offs between speed, resilience, cost, and maintainability. Foster Technical Leadership & Culture: Mentor and elevate senior engineers, lead architectural design reviews, and establish engineering best practices that raise the bar across the organization. Uphold Platform Resilience: Act as a senior escalation point for high-severity incidents, lead rigorous post-mortems, and institute systemic safeguards to ensure 24/7 unshakeable platform integrity. What you bring Extensive Technical Leadership : 8+ years of relevant experience in backend and distributed systems engineering, with a proven track record of operating as a technical lead or Staff-level engineer in high-scale environments. Deep Cloud & Container Mastery : Advanced architectural expertise with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and enterprise-scale AWS cloud services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB). Distributed Systems & Low-Latency Acumen: Deep understanding of high-concurrency, low-latency backend architectures, event-driven systems, fault tolerance, and data consistency models. Strategic Autonomy & Execution: Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, organization-wide problems from inception to production, successfully delivering high-impact business outcomes. items.title: Lead Generation Strategy and Operations
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for someone to join our team in Lead Generation Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision. As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment. In this role, you will be responsible for: - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption. - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Events, Partner) to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness. - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting. - Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area. - Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across pre-sales functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement. - Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance. Who you are We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you: - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech. - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead. - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset. - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations. - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside. What you bring - 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies - Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution. - Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma) - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement. - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
